scenes.title: The Prisoner
scenes.biggestGap: G4-001: Cyndia steps past Sylvanas into the storeroom light, then only Sylvanas steps back over the threshold. Cyndia is left shut in with the prisoner.

sceneContract.placeAnchor: Storeroom threshold, door eased to a hand's width of blue light
sceneContract.povAnchor: Sylvanas takes the room by its door and who stands on which side
sceneContract.dialogueAnchor: Cyndia lowers her voice; door eased shut before she turns the book
sceneContract.exitAnchor: Door and ward-light circle around the chair, unchanged
